name: Hyatt Regency Kinabalu
short_description: A 288-room waterfront Hyatt Regency in central Kota Kinabalu, opened in 1977 and last renovated in 2011, with six dining options and a Regency Club.
ai_summary: Hyatt Regency Kinabalu sits on the waterfront in central Kota Kinabalu, giving guests easy access to the city's markets and island ferries on foot. Guests praise the friendly, generous staff, comfortable beds, and clean bathrooms, along with a well-regarded breakfast spread across the hotel's six dining venues. Opened in 1977 and last renovated in 2011, the property is one of the older Hyatt properties in the directory, and a number of reviewers describe the interior as tired and in need of a refresh, with the breakfast buffet's a-la-carte pricing also drawing criticism as overpriced relative to nearby options.

pros: Waterfront location in central Kota Kinabalu, walkable to markets and island ferries
Staff repeatedly described as friendly and generous
Clean rooms with comfortable beds and great linens
Breakfast draws praise, served across six dining options
Central location well suited to exploring the city without a car
cons: The interior is described by several reviewers as dated and in need of renovation
Breakfast buffet pricing (around RM67) is seen as overpriced compared with nearby local options (RM15-20)
research_highlights: Guests consistently praise the waterfront, central location for exploring Kota Kinabalu
Staff friendliness and the breakfast spread draw repeated positive comment
Rooms and bathrooms are described as clean with comfortable bedding
research_watchouts: Multiple reviews describe the property as tired-looking and not fully matching 5-star expectations given its age
The a-la-carte breakfast buffet is called overpriced relative to dining options just outside the hotel

faqs.question: Is Hyatt Regency Kinabalu in central Kota Kinabalu?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's on the waterfront in the city centre, within walking distance of local markets and the jetty for island ferries, making it a convenient base for exploring Kota Kinabalu without needing a car.

faqs.question: Has Hyatt Regency Kinabalu been renovated recently?
faqs.answer: It opened in 1977 and was last renovated in 2011, so it's one of the older properties in the directory. Several reviewers note the interior feels dated compared with the city's newer hotels, even though rooms remain clean and comfortable.
